summary.zh-Hans: 大通公园在札幌市中心东西延伸，有草坪、树木、花坛和喷泉。
summary.en: Odori Park runs east to west through central Sapporo, with lawns, trees, flowerbeds and fountains.

summary.zh-Hans: 莫埃来沼公园是札幌的艺术公园，设有三角轮廓的莫埃来山和名为Hidamari的玻璃金字塔。
summary.en: Moerenuma is an art park in Sapporo with the triangular silhouette of Mount Moere and a glass pyramid called Hidamari.

summary.zh-Hans: 札幌味噌拉面以味噌汤配中粗卷面，配料可有豆芽和洋葱。
summary.en: Sapporo miso ramen combines miso broth with medium-thick curly noodles. Toppings can include bean sprouts and onion.

summary.zh-Hans: 汤咖喱是札幌可见的料理，将蔬菜放入带有香料的汤底。
summary.en: Soup curry is found in Sapporo and combines vegetables with a spiced soup base.
